Every task is test-first: the test cites its FR/NR id, fails first, then passes. Every guard gets a mutant that turns
the suite red (constitution 3). New tests go in `tests/smoke-github-board.sh` (part 8) unless a task names another
file. `R<n> #<m>` refers to plan.md Revision n, item m.

## Phase 1: Setup

- [x] T001 [FR-009] `tests/smoke-github-board.sh` + the source line in `tests/smoke.sh`. `FakeGhProject` is a named
  fake gh script, injected through `HEFESTO_GH_BIN`. It serves canned JSON by argv: GraphQL issue, paged items,
  `repositoryOwner`, `projectsV2`, `field-list`, `project view`, `issue create`, `issue edit`, `issue comment`,
  `project item-add`, `project item-edit`, and `api …/collaborators/<login>` (204 or 404). It logs every argv, and
  its `*) exit 1` arm makes an unexpected call fail, never return "". Plus a fixture board config, and a one-repo
  Project fixture with 3 Todo issues, a draft item, a PR, and one issue from another repo. `tests/smoke-github-board.sh`
- [x] T002 [FR-001] Move `--detect` and `--init` (`status-board.sh:86-122`) into a sourced `hooks/board-setup.sh`,
  sourced before the argument loop (`:33`) with no behaviour change. The existing detect and init smoke cases pass
  unchanged. Add an empty sourced `hooks/board-github.sh`, and `ghb_parse_arg`: the loop's `*)` arm shifts by the
  count it returns, and 0 keeps the `exit 2` "unknown option" message (R2 #5). Test: an unknown option still exits 2.
  `hooks/board-setup.sh`

## Phase 2: Foundational

## Phase 3: User Stories (by priority)

### P1 — Must Have

- [x] T006 [FR-001] [US1] `--list <col>` for both sources.
  - tasks-repo: the column's ids from `column_items`; a test asserts they equal the ids `--detailed` shows.
  - github-project: resolve the options first. A column key absent from `columns`, or a mapped name that is not an
    option, refuses, naming the options through `safe_list` (R1 #2, review nit).
  - Tests: `--list todo` → the 3 ids; a misspelled `"In progress"` refuses (mutant: the check skipped).
  `hooks/status-board.sh`
- [x] T007 [FR-003] [US2] `ghb_body`: the heading `## <id> — <title>` plus the body with CRLF normalised.
  `--item-raw` prints it as written; `--item` passes it through `as_untrusted`. `body_of` dispatches by source.
  Tests: comments stripped, delimiters present, CRLF and LF bodies hash the same. `hooks/board-github.sh`
- [x] T008 [FR-004] [US2] `--item-kind` from labels (`kinds_labels`, default bug/incident → incident,
  security → vulnerability). Tests: the default map, a configured map, and no label → feature.
  `hooks/board-github.sh`
- [x] T009 [FR-005] [US2] `item_rfc` reads its body through `body_of`, so the tasks-repo path rules are reused
  (one implementation). Tests on github-project: a valid line resolves; two `rfc:` lines refuse; a `..` path
  refuses; a missing file refuses. The tasks-repo RFC cases pass unchanged. `hooks/status-board.sh`
- [x] T010 [FR-007] [NR-003] `--item-url` and `--item-trust`.
  - trust: the author's association must be in `orchestrate.trusted_associations` (default OWNER, MEMBER,
    COLLABORATOR; a configured `NONE` refuses the config).
  - When the editor differs from the author, `api repos/<r>/collaborators/<login>` must answer 204; 404 means
    untrusted. Exit 3 = untrusted with the reason; any other non-zero = could not read.
  - Tests: each association; an editor 204 / 404 / 500; NONE configured. One mutant per check.
  `hooks/board-github.sh`
- [x] T011 [FR-006] [FR-007] [NR-003] The born-blocked entry (R1 #1).
  - `ledger.sh init --intake-file <f>`: copy `<f>` to `$DIR/<id>.intake.md`, and set
    `blocked_on = {kind: human:intake, since, question_path}` in the one `jq … | write_entry` at `:406-410`. A
    failed copy refuses before the write.
  - `register_item`: the kind comes from the board's `source`, adding `--url`. It reads url and trust before
    `init`; trust exit 3 → `--intake-file`, any other failure refuses with no entry.
  - Tests:
    - an untrusted author → the first read of the entry shows `human:intake`;
    - a read-only ledger dir leaves no entry;
    - tasks-repo registration is unchanged;
    - mutant: the `blocked_on` clause dropped goes red.
  `hooks/ledger-lanes.sh`
- [x] T012 [FR-003] [NR-002] Single-read launcher (R1 #10, R2 #5).
  - `item_as_data` and `rfc_as_data`'s duplicate strip/nonce code move to a sourced `hooks/launch-item.sh`.
    `item_as_data` reads `--item-raw` once into a temp file, hashes it, and shows `--as-untrusted <id> < file`.
  - `session-launch.sh` loses lines; the existing launch dry-run tests pass unchanged.
  - Test: a fake gh whose body changes between calls can't pass the hash with one text and show another.
  `hooks/launch-item.sh`
- [x] T013 [FR-008] [US4] `--add <title> [--rfc | --body-file <f>] [--incident]`, for both sources.
  - The pair `--rfc` + `--body-file` is refused.
  - tasks-repo `--body-file` appends the text and refuses any line matching `ITEM_HEADING` (mutant).
  - github-project:
    - `issue create` (with the body file), then with `--rfc`, `issue edit <the created number> --body "rfc: …"`;
    - `project item-add`, then the Status set to todo.
    - A failure after create exits 1, naming the issue URL, and prints no id.
  - Tests: the `issue edit` argv carries the number `create` returned; each failure step.
  `hooks/board-github.sh`
- [x] T014 [FR-008] `/hef.ship`: the bug-fix path writes the description to a file and passes `--body-file`,

- [x] T015 [FR-009] [NR-004] Read modes write nothing (R1 #11). After `--list`, `--item`, `--item-raw`,
  `--item-kind`, `--item-rfc`, `--item-url`, `--item-trust`, `--detect` and `--check`, the fake gh's argv log holds
